title: Humility in the Teaching of Jesus
reading:
Jesus equates greatness with childlikeness. The humble heart does not demand position.

He warns: those who exalt themselves will be humbled. The kingdom runs opposite the world's system.
reflection: Do I secretly seek recognition? How do I respond when overlooked? Where do I measure my worth by comparison?
abide: The kingdom belongs to those who come as children — not as the accomplished, but as the dependent. Rest in that.
